scripts.preflight: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Docker daemon is not running — start Docker Desktop first.' && exit 1)
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run preflight && supabase db reset
scripts.db:diff: pnpm run preflight && supabase db diff -f
scripts.//test: Runs against the LIVE local database, so it stays out of Turborepo like every other db:* command — see README. Container name is derived from project_id in config.toml.
scripts.test:concurrency: pnpm run preflight && bash tests/invitation-concurrency.e2e.sh && bash tests/email-verification-concurrency.e2e.sh && bash tests/password-reset-concurrency.e2e.sh && bash tests/mfa-recovery-concurrency.e2e.sh && bash tests/m2-v1-release-concurrency.e2e.sh
scripts.db:types: pnpm run preflight && mkdir -p supabase/types && supabase gen types --local --schema public > supabase/types/database.types.ts && node scripts/normalize-database-types.mjs supabase/types/database.types.ts ../api/src/supabase/database.types.ts
scripts.//db:types: Generated types are copied into apps/api so the Supabase client can be typed as SupabaseClient<Database>. Without the generic, .rpc() rejects every argument object and every query result is `any` — which means unsafe-member-access casts scattered through the services.
